messages:
Maria: Quick follow-up to the low-bit support RFC. I want to propose a tiny runtime ABI/mapping layer so FP8/INT8/4bit variants are drop-in for serving configs. This is mostly about metadata layout (per-layer scales, qtype tags) and a compatibility fallback path. Thoughts?
Kevin: +1 to an ABI. Main ask: where do we store per-layer calibration stats? embedding/linear/attn all need different scales. We should standardize a small 'q-meta' blob per artifact.
Sam: For rollout safety we need clear eval gates. Suggest keeping two metrics: relative perplexity change (ppl_delta <= 1.02) and distributional shift (KL <= 0.04) on a standard holdout. Also record token-level error rates on prompt-suite.
Anjali: Canary/rollout plan: put an example config here:
```
canary:
  policy: slice-based
  slices: user_locale, prompt_type
  fraction: 0.01
  rollback_on: ppl_delta>1.02 OR kl>0.04
```
Keeping it narrow to start.
Maria: Good. ABI sketch: minimal fields: qtype ("fp8"|"int8"|"4bit"), per_layer_scales: [float], per_tensor_zero_point optional, calibr_version, checksum. Runtime will map unknown qtype -> float fallback. Example artifact header:
```
{"qtype":"int8","calib_v":"2026-03-10","scales":"base64-blob","meta":{"capabilities":["kv_cache"],"max_seq":2048}}
```
Kevin: How do we handle mixed precision within a model (attn fp8, ff int8)? Need tagging per-tensor. Maybe store a small index map: layer->scheme.
Sam: Also need eval-aware tuning: some tasks degrade gracefully, others catastrophically. We should tag 'safety-sensitive' layers to opt them out of 4-bit.
quant-ci: Quick CI run on toy-model-8: int8 mapping + fallback -> avg ppl change 1.006, KL 0.018. 4-bit aggressive quant (our default recipe) -> ppl 1.09, KL 0.12 (fail). Full logs: https://ci.internal/quant/2528
Anjali: So policy: model artifact must include 'quality_profile' with pass thresholds. Runtime refuses to serve artifact unless profile.runtype == "hosted_approved" or canary is on.
Maria: Ops question: Dedicated customers may want to opt out of telemetry gating. We can make gating an opt-in per-deployment flag but require explicit acknowledgement in the contract.
deploy-bot: Note: deployment template needs new flag `allow_lowbit` and `quality_profile_hash` added. We'll block deploys without it if policy.enforce == true.
Kevin: Implementation detail: store per-layer scales as compressed varint stream to keep header < 128KB. Also include a 'compat_version' integer to allow future changes.
Sam: Next actions: (1) I can draft a small RFC addendum with ABI sketch + eval gating tests, (2) Anjali can write canary playbook, (3) Maria will sync with legal on Dedicated opt-outs.
Maria: Thanks — let's reconvene after RFC addendum. :thumbsup: 
quant-ci: FYI: I'll schedule nightly regression on a small task suite and post trends. :eyes:
